description_en: The south-facing Bāhālukhā Phalcā is dedicated to Triliṅgeśvara Mahādeva and is located to the north of the temple. A stone inscription embedded in its wall records that Amātya Rāma Bhāro, Govindarāja Bhāro and others jointly commissioned and engaged in the construction of thephalcāin order to sing devotional songs and hymns (bhajana) to Triliṅgeśvara Mahādeva. The first digit of the date recorded in the inscription is not clearly readable but most likely refers to 1761 CE (NS 881). In 1892 (VS 1949), Amātya Kṛṣṇagovinda, his wife Mānakumārī and two sons commissioned the repair of thephalcā. In 2009 CE (VS 2065), local community members and the Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City jointly reconstructed it. Special singing events (bhajana)dedicated to Triliṅgeśvara Mahādeva used to be organised on the day of Śivarātrī; however, since the 1970s, such events have come to an end.
description_ne: बाहालुखा टोलमा अवस्थित त्रिलिङ्गेश्वर महादेव मन्दिर (LAL0250) को उत्तरमा यो फल्चा निर्माण गरिएको छ । दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको यस फल्चामा कुनै देवीदेवताहरूको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएका छैनन् । त्रिलिङ्गेश्वर महादेवको सम्मानमा भजन गर्न नेसं ८८१? (सन् १७६१?) मा अमात्य राम भारो, ग्वविन्दराज (गोविन्दराज) भारो लगायत अन्य व्यक्तिहरू मिलेर यो फल्चाको निर्माण गरिएको थियो । विसं १९४९ (सन् १८९२) मा दौ बाहा: टोलमा बस्ने अमात्य कृष्नगोविन्दले श्रीमती र दुई जना छोराहरूसँग मिलेर यो फल्चाको जीर्णोद्धार गरेका थिए । पुन: विसं २०६५ (सन् २००९) मा ललितपुर उप-महानगरपालिका र स्थानीवासीहरूको संयुक्त प्रयासमा फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । पहिले यस फल्चामा धेरै भजन हुन्थे । शिवरात्रीको दिनमा त्रिलिङ्गेश्वर महादेव मन्दिरमा रुद्री पूजा गरी धुनी जगाउँदा यस फल्चामा विशेष भजन गरिन्थ्यो । विगत ५०  वर्षदेखि यस फल्चामा भजन बन्द भएको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Amātya Rāma Bhāro, Govindarāja Bhāro and others jointly commissioned and engaged in the construction of thephalcā. The first digit of the date recorded in the inscription is not clearly readable.
Amātya Kṛṣṇagovinda, his wife Mānakumārī and two sons commissioned the repairing of thephalcā.

In 2009 CE (VS 2065), local community members and the Department of Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City jointly engaged in the reconstruction of thephalcā. The Sub-metroplitian City contributed 4,35,742 Rupees to this endeavor.
